unreached.one: {unreached} of {count} changed function no test reaches
unreached.other: {unreached} of {count} changed functions no test reaches

reached.one: a test reaches the changed function

reachedPartly: tests reach every changed function Haunt reads tests for
unread: tests not read for {count} (PHP, Rust or Lua)

busy.one: touches a busy file ({name}, {commits} commits in {days} days)
busy.other: touches {count} busy files (the busiest {name}, {commits} commits in {days} days)

quiet: nothing calls it, and it touches no busy file
hint: {reasons}. Based on callers, tests and the last {days} days of changes: a hint for where to look first.
